items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Jim BEEBE on trombone, Barney Bigard, Barrett Deems on drums, Art Hodes on piano and me on cornet.

ctx.x: Jim BEEBE on trombone, Barney Bigard, Barrett Deems on drums, Art Hodes on piano and me on cornet. And we're do that for three months up until, January, February, March until the end of March. And May I go up to Albany, New York, I'll have Slam Stewart on bass and some little place up, I can't remember the name. It's in Albany for four weeks. That's May. June I haven't booked. But in July for six weeks for all of July and two weeks of August, I'll be going back to Durban, South Africa. So I'm practically booked…
